sentences.text: Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
This is first application u/S.438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail by the petitioner.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with offence punishable u/S. 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of Indian Penal Code registered as Crime No.17/2024 by Police Station Economic Offence Wing (EOW), Jabalpur Unit.

entities.text: Police Station Economic Offence Wing (EOW), Jabalpur Unit
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
The petitioner apprehends arrest in respect to offences of cheating and forgery along with criminal conspiracy arising out of execution of particular lease deed sometime in the year 2004-2006.
Though it is submitted by the State counsel that petitioner has several criminal antecedents registered against him and investigation in this matter is pending.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the nature of the offence and the fact that petitioner has already extended benefit of bail in all the other offences alleged against him, this Court is inclined to extend the benefit of bail to the petitioner, but with certain stringent conditions in view of the nature of the offence.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I deem it appropriate to allow this application u/S. 438 of Cr.P.C. in the following terms.

It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rs.One lacs only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.
A copy of this order be sent to the Court below for compliance.
